decisions.reason: The protection cap benefits from the firm's knowledge of trailer couplings, but as a peripheral accessory it has moderate absorptive capacity, so the firm keeps it while monitoring.
Box car trailers are squarely within the firm's core trailer manufacturing knowledge, enabling it to assimilate early results and improve the series.
Car transporter trailers extend the firm's trailer platform into a specialized segment, where existing chassis and fabrication knowledge supports learning.
Low-bed trailers leverage the firm's semi-trailer engineering capabilities, providing strong absorptive capacity for improvements.
High trailer covers require textile and cover expertise outside the firm's metal trailer core, limiting its ability to interpret results and improve, so it is dropped.
This box car trailer series, like product B, draws on existing enclosed trailer knowledge, supporting a keep decision.
